about: A golden vector of the filtered draw's distribution (RND-9, ADR 0002).
It does not assert that the distribution is right — the filter shifts it away from the nominal
weights by construction, and there is nothing to compare it against. It asserts that it has not
CHANGED: every edit to the reduction, the recovery, the resolution rules or the order in which a
draw touches the stream shows up here as a diff instead of as a silently different game.
Regenerating these counts is a deliberate act. The version above is bumped when they move, and
the commit that moves them says why.
